svg.title: Bridge architecture
svg.desc: Bridge architecture — Claude Code ↔ Codex — two directions, one supervisor
svg.text: Claude Code ↔ Codex — two directions, one supervisor
↺ dashed = same stage reused, see its home card

g.text: reverse = host-launched MCP server, never a shell command from a sandboxed Codex turn
binding ID + workspace + fingerprint, or null
no peer, provider, write, repair or auth

svg.text: target=peer · approval-bound · no model in the loop

g.text: drift / expiry / replay → approval invalid · fault → stop, no hidden retry
sync = static doctor only: no setup skill, token, auth, repair or provider call

svg.text: home of every ↺ result · core · metadata · transcript-only

g.text: fault → incident: open its JSON path before fault
model cannot claim timing, cost, lifecycle or identity
digest can't rebuild output · capture bytes ≠ provider tokens
Codex thread ID ≠ Claude session ID
detached run + Codex session continuation: forward CLI route only
no edit, auth or paid consent
Refused folders — typed or proposed alike
by identity: / · ~ and every dir above · plugin/cache · ~/.claude · ~/.codex
and the dirs named by CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR / CODEX_HOME
no bind on: unsupported form · malformed reply · stale ID · decline / cancel · EOF
folder + identity rechecked before dispatch; change → unbind
Windows: native path checks · execution still a verification surface
Diagram only — the bridge code is normative; update this with any transport, tool, setup or binding change.
